What’s better than driving the new 852bhp Pagani Utopia Roadster? Driving it alongside its open-top predecessors, the Zonda F Roadster and company founder Horacio Pagani’s own one-of-one Huayra HP Roadster. It’s the ultimate Pagani test, a slice of V12 heaven, as we test Horacio Pagani’s greatest hypercars!
Pagani Utopia, Huayra & Zonda Roadsters
Jethro Bovingdon
